long_biography.plain_text:
Acquisition and redevelopment have shaped Mario Gravanis’s work at Oscars Group. The company grew over several decades by purchasing hospitality properties, improving selected sites and moving from local pubs into accommodation hotels, resorts and mixed-use venue assets across Sydney and beyond.

Gravanis serves as a director, distinct from the group’s chief executive and management team. The brothers have continued to make portfolio decisions together, including interstate expansion and the sale of selected venues for operational consolidation. Their ownership model combines venue operations with the property underlying many of the group’s businesses.
